normalization: population zscore from eligible strictly previous-date candidate features only; zero variance scale=1
same_day_policy: exclude entire same date because official finalization times are unknown
roi_transform: R/(1+R), R=payout_yen/(600*n) in multiples, not percent
missing_policy: missing corpus/query features or n=0 =>0 with explicit status; no legacy fallback
disclaimer: Uncalibrated composite index, NOT a hit probability. Frozen-model retrospective corpus uses official measured moisture and includes1049 training-source races; not pure unseen/prestart performance.
